uslaw-usc-t2-s167j:
Section 167j of Title 2 of the United States Code defines the area of the Library of Congress grounds. Title 2 covers Congress, and this section sits in the chapter on the Library of Congress. The hosted text is the version current in twenty twenty six. Precise street lines fix the legal edge of those grounds.

The grounds extend to the east curb of First Street Southeast between two named streets, the text states. They also extend to the south curb of East Capitol Street for a set stretch. More boundary lines follow in the same precise form. The term buildings and grounds is defined for use across the chapter. Police and care duties turn on those lines.
